title: a16z Podcast: When Is VR's iPhone Moment?

reader_summary.source_label: From the episode notes — transcript not yet available
reader_summary.headline: There was a lot of hype about VR ad then it seemed to go pretty quiet.
reader_summary.overview: There was a lot of hype about VR ad then it seemed to go pretty quiet. Bigscreen founder Darshan Shankar and a16z general partner Chris Dixon take the pulse on VR, AR. The conversation surveys some of the key platforms and devices -- from ARKit to the various headsets from various players -- to where we are in hardware, software.

key_points.text: Bigscreen founder Darshan Shankar and a16z general partner Chris Dixon take the pulse on VR, AR.
The conversation surveys some of the key platforms and devices -- from ARKit to the various headsets from various players -- to where we are in hardware.
Are these destined to be just fun gadgets, or will they become new tools that demand continuous use and engagement?
